text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking down the hallway,
I ran into 
Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Thank goodness, it's you,
Trainer. 
I thought you were another teacher.
choice_data_list: Did something happen between you a...
Did something happen between you a...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: It's nothing major. Just the usual thing.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Go to class." "At least turn in your 
reports." "Meet your deadlines."... That 
sort of thing—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Haa... My head and heart both feel so 
heavy...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to take a short walk outside to 
clear my head. See you later.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. would be plagued by a headache 
for quite some time, all thanks to that 
relentless nagging...
